why: help given freely and help traded for help look the same in a thread unless the return is spelled out.

why.T3-011: The bulk of the item is SFU members sending pixels to the UVic mark and agreeing to keep helping, which is help given to another room's work; asking is present but the giving leads.
why.T3-084: C1133487 and C0258269 are the room asking another canvas group, in their own thread, for hands on its own work, which T3-011's gate does not reach.

multiplacement_log.why_not_one: T3-011 would leave the room's own requests for hands, made to another university group, uncarried.
multiplacement_log.why_this_one: C1133487 and C0258269 are requests addressed to another canvas room as a group for help with this room's work.
multiplacement_log.dispensable: T3-084, losing the asking direction of the cross-university help.

why.T3-009: C1404759 and C0169835 mark the finished logo as achieved, which the crediting gate does not cover.

multiplacement_log.why_not_one: T3-043 covers the thanking and recognition but not the marking of the work as achieved.
multiplacement_log.why_this_one: C1404759 and C0169835 mark the finished logo as a victory, which is T3-009's own doing.
multiplacement_log.dispensable: T3-009, losing only the small celebratory thread.

why.T3-002: The single concept is a reply inside a Frog-making call to place, the room's own members being summoned and answered; the nearest other, T3-034, needs a request for coordinates, which 'Wat' is not.

why.T3-044: The sign and label are staged on the canvas and in the thread to bring people to the sub, which is advertising to draw visitors in, not T3-169's plain signing.

why.T3-119: C0144774, C0097776 and C0688997 have the attackers actually helping repair the Parahumans work, which the apology gate does not reach.

why.T3-070: The item circulates the logo image, the coordinates and neighbours so placers can reproduce the work, which is directions shared, not T3-020's blank spot-finding.

multiplacement_log.why_not_one: T3-062 covers the appeals for outside hands but not the flag that is the work being made.
multiplacement_log.why_this_one: C0733621 and C0159242 build and defend the Taiwan flag as the room's mark.
multiplacement_log.dispensable: T3-065, losing the flag itself but keeping the recruiting.

why.T3-005: The item is an attack under way on the Omani flag and calls to hold it, which is the defence gate, not T3-021's attacker-less upkeep.

why.T3-038: C0108078 and C0882006 begin and continue placing the mark and report its state, which the extension gate does not reach.
why.T3-002: C0661436 and C0804558 call on others to come and place, which neither of the building gates covers.

why.T3-149: Peace and truces asked, offered, agreed and honoured with neighbours and rivals run through the item, which is ending or forestalling fights between rooms in contact; alliances, room-granting and thanks are present at the floor as their own themes and stay in the bag record.
